title: the G22b scratch tree is created and never removed on any path -- no rm, no trap (all four dispositions cleared at :7271), and outside the suite's trap-covered $TMP root -- so every wave7-smoke.sh run leaks one directory containing a full synthetic SRD/G22RDC/ initiative, on the SUCCESS path, twice per CI pipeline plus every developer's pre-push run-all.sh; its otherwise character-identical G22a sibling at :7241/:7255 does have the tail rm, so this is a dropped line rather than a project pattern; fix by rooting it at "${TMP}/edm-g22b.XXXXXX" so the top-level trap at :25 reclaims it by construction, and consider a bin/tests tripwire since the T61 AC11 sweep at :1137 excludes /tests/

eleven scratch trees (:5116, :5154, :5190, :5217, :5242, :5282, :5331, :5386, :5535, :7241, :7826) are rooted at ${TMPDIR:-/tmp} instead of the suite's trap-covered $TMP, inside subshells that correctly clear all four inherited trap dispositions and then leave a tail-position rm -rf as the only cleanup; source "$EDM_STATE" re-enables errexit inside them (the suite states this itself at :5163-5165) and several statements are unguarded (:5251's bare cat of a stderr file that only exists if the code under test failed as expected), so a regression in edm-state aborts the subshell before its own cleanup -- CA-450's aggravator verbatim -- and a Ctrl-C leaks these eleven while the parent trap reclaims the ~45 siblings; the consistent-pattern filter fails cleanly since wave6-smoke.sh:456-458 states the $TMP-nesting rule outright; fix is one token per site, same commit as L5-001

CA-449 RE-VERIFIED FIXED: cmd_compare's two staging files now use the house ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/edm-score-compare-*.XXXXXX template with checked creation, the four-signal split trap is installed before the first jq write and is the sole cleanup path (tail rm removed), and the T61 AC11 tripwire alternation at wave7-smoke.sh:1137 was widened to mktemp( -d)?\) so the non-directory template-less form is banned; no other trap in the file was clobbered

CA-450 RE-VERIFIED FIXED: one process-wide _timing_cleanup covers all five mode scratch variables on EXIT plus signal-shaped INT/TERM/HUP, set -u-safe via ${VAR:-} and set -e-safe via return 0; --generate-fixture's DIR is correctly excluded per the finding's explicit carve-out

CA-446 RE-VERIFIED FIXED at all three sites: edm-sync-canonical-sections:90-93 (the CI --check fabricated-drift scenario is closed), edm-lint-artifacts:149-152 and edm-check-grants:131-134 all now split EXIT from INT/TERM/HUP with 130/143/129 exits after cleanup

CA-447 / L8-006 RE-VERIFIED FIXED including the first-stage trap: edm-lint-artifacts:137 arms a single-file trap immediately after the first mktemp at :133 and is superseded by the two-file split traps at :149-152; HUP is present at all six previously three-signal sites (wave7-smoke.sh:25, harness-smoke.sh:264, _harness.sh:85 and :114, plus the two scanners) and edm-check-grants:124-130's comment now states the real four-signal convention rather than the weaker floor

CA-442 RE-VERIFIED FIXED: _cmd_migrate_path_rollback_body now sweeps "${_src}/.edm-state.lockd" after the reverse rename with a comment explaining why with_state_lock's destination-path cleanup cannot see it; the flock .lock file is correctly left in place per CA-169, mirroring both forward movers

CA-443 RE-VERIFIED FIXED (clamp half): keep is clamped to a floor of 1 with a named CA-443 stderr diagnostic after the digit-only validator, so EDM_EVAL_KEEP_RUNS=0 can no longer delete the run that just finished; the second prescribed half -- a structural current-run-ID skip inside the prune loop at :214-221 -- did NOT land, but the clamp makes it unreachable and it is L3's finding, so not re-filed

after CA-447's sweep this is the last trap in the plugin omitting HUP, and it also resumes on INT/TERM rather than exiting (CA-446's class); it was named in CA-291's NOTED site list and was outside CA-447's prescribed set, the resource is a TMPDIR-rooted file in a developer-invoked --self-test mode; standing under CA-291's do-not-re-file disposition, recorded only so edm-check-grants:124-130's one-signal-set claim is read with this exception in mind

the three untrapped mktemp files at :115, :139 and :191 are re-verified present and unchanged; CA-171 carries the do-not-re-file disposition (TMPDIR-only, tiny, inline rm -f, assertion helpers never exit early) and :263-264's scratch dir was correctly widened to four signals by CA-447

bare template-less mktemp -d at :290 and :572 unchanged; both install trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT and run inside a throwaway CI container, and :523 uses a proper template with an inline rm -f -- round-8 N6's container-ephemeral reasoning holds and nothing reaches a worktree

per-initiative .gitignore coverage re-verified COMPLETE: cmd_init:2092-2099 and edm-init's mirrored heredoc write the same six lines, and every runtime write into an initiative directory matches one of them -- the .bak at :738, all five write_atomic destinations (:739, :2043, :4286, :5150, :5773) whose staging path is <dest>.tmp.XXXXXX from :664, and the full lock family including .lockd.stale.<pid>; cmd_init returns early at :2078-2080 before the cat > so a re-init cannot clobber a hand-extended file

root **/*.lock would silently untrack a Cargo.lock/Gemfile.lock/poetry.lock if one were ever added to this repository (none exists, and there is no build step); the consumer-facing copy is NOT this pattern -- README.md:228-235's block is explicitly a PER-INITIATIVE .gitignore written into the initiative directory, where *.lock cannot reach a project-root dependency lockfile, so no footgun ships

newly in this round's named scope and clean: no mktemp, no redirection to a path, no mkdir anywhere -- pure git diff --cached to awk to subprocess dispatch, so the extracted commit hook adds no runtime-file surface

CA-440's fix added no runtime-file surface: the SubagentStop prompt now writes qc/qc-shard-{NN}.md and mkdir -p's <initiative-dir>/qc, both documented tracked artifacts bounded by ticket count and overwritten rather than appended on re-run; no other hook redirects to a path of its own and monitors.json's watch-impl remains a read-only git log poll

eval retention re-verified sound: runs/.gitignore is self-ignoring, prune_old_runs is the body of all four traps at :271-274 so partial and interrupted runs are retention-managed, and the run-ID shape filter now runs BEFORE both the count and the keep window -- which fully closes CA-292's surviving off-by-N sliver; --provision-only's deliberate retention at :260 stands under round-8 N1

with_scratch_repo references a `local` inside its trap body while its sibling harness_scratch_dir uses a deliberate non-local and documents why at :78-83; verified SAFE because the trap is installed at :114 and torn down at :143 before the function returns, so it only fires while dir is in dynamic scope -- the asymmetry with the sibling's own comment is a readability question for another lens, not a leak

CA-130 recurred a seventh time: this lens's delivered tool set was Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch and TaskStop -- no Write and no Bash -- so both output halves are returned inline per the step-8a fallback, and the prescribed 833a06d..HEAD diff review was replaced by a read-based verification of the tree at HEAD; flag for the round's tooling-notes.md
